cars.generation: Original TR7/TR8 wedge sports-car road family, selected factory V8

cars.generation: Original Lotus-powered Jensen-Healey open sports-car family
cars.variant: Mark II — US-facing four-speed brochure reference
cars.specification_market: Original Jensen Motors Mark II brochure, catalogued by host as 1974 USA version 2. Eight pages rendered; engine PDF5 and specifications PDF8 enlarged and read. The brochure itself has no authenticated issue date: year remains unset. It includes USA-specific warnings and US correspondence. No SAE-net standard is invented for its native 140 BHP. cars.summary: The Jensen-Healey joined two established British sports-car names around a light-alloy Lotus four-valve engine. Its combination of traditional open two-seat motoring with sixteen-valve engine design makes it a distinctive bridge between the Healey era and the next generation of British sports cars.

cars.generation: Original Volvo-powered wooden-monocoque Marcos road coupe

cars.generation: Original compact Grantura sports coupe family, selected torsion-bar Mark IIA
cars.specification_market: Original TVR Cars Mark IIA 12-page brochure, hosted by TVR Car Club. All pages rendered; PDF8–9 technical spread read separately.
